title.original: A Multi-Memory Segment System for Generating High-Quality Long-Term Memory Content in Agents
title.zh: 一种在智能体中生成高质量长期内存内容的多内存段系统
title.en: A Multi-Memory Segment System for Generating High-Quality Long-Term Memory Content in Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: MMS 提供从短期对话生成多类长期片段、双单元存储和映射检索的完整可复用记忆流水线。
inclusion_reason.en: MMS provides a reusable end-to-end memory pipeline from short-term dialogue through multi-segment generation, paired storage, and mapped retrieval.

abstract.zh: MMS 受认知心理学启发，将短期对话加工成多个长期记忆片段，而非只保存单一摘要。每个片段生成一一对应的检索单元和高保真上下文单元，查询时先匹配轻量索引，再取回配套内容供回答。
abstract.en: MMS converts short-term interaction into multiple long-term memory segments rather than a single summary. Each segment yields a lightweight retrieval unit paired one-to-one with a richer context unit, so queries match the former and responses consume the latter.

problem.zh: 多数 Agent 记忆研究优化检索，却把历史压成低质量摘要；摘要丢失多维细节后，即使召回正确也会降低回答质量。
problem.en: Most agent-memory work optimizes retrieval while storing low-fidelity dialogue summaries; once multidimensional detail is lost, even correct recall may not support a good response.

approach.zh: 系统从短期记忆生成多类片段，再分别构造检索表征和上下文表征；用户查询只在检索单元上匹配，并通过映射获取对应的完整上下文。
approach.en: The system derives multiple segment types from short-term memory and builds separate retrieval and context representations; queries search only retrieval units and follow the pairing to full context.

system_design.zh: MMS 包含短期记忆分段器、片段内容生成器、双单元存储和检索映射；索引与回答上下文分离，使召回效率不必以压缩内容质量为代价。
system_design.en: MMS comprises a short-term segmenter, segment-content generator, paired-unit store, and retrieval mapping. Separating the index from response context avoids making recall efficiency depend on compressed content.

key_results.zh: LoCoMo、消融、输入记忆规模鲁棒性和开销实验共同表明，多片段内容设计改善长期记忆利用，并具备实际运行价值。
key_results.en: LoCoMo, ablation, memory-count robustness, and overhead experiments collectively report better long-term memory use and practical viability from multi-segment content.

limitations.zh: 片段类型与生成质量依赖模型和认知假设，一一映射也难以表达跨片段关系；证据集中在 LoCoMo，长期更新、冲突与遗忘机制未见摘要说明。
limitations.en: Segment types and quality depend on model and cognitive assumptions, while one-to-one pairing cannot naturally express cross-segment relations; evidence centers on LoCoMo and does not describe revision, conflict, or forgetting.

notes.zh: LoCoMo、消融、记忆数量鲁棒性和开销实验来自官方摘要；模型、基线、硬件及具体结果待全文审计。
notes.en: LoCoMo, ablations, memory-count robustness, and overhead evaluation come from the official abstract; models, baselines, hardware, and values await full-text audit.
